data.long_meaning: Magan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Mandagini’, which refers to the moon. The moon is considered a divine and powerful symbol in Hindu mythology, representing the cycle of life and the passage of time. The name Magan is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, wisdom, and protection. The name Magan carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Magan usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
